name: cpi_services_ex_shelter_yoy
notes: Year-over-year % change in basket-weighted services CPI excluding shelter. Synthetic ex-shelter level reconstructed per basket cycle from StatCan Table 18-10-0007-01 weights (cpi_basket_weights_canada.csv): L_t = (w_services_t * services_index_t - w_shelter_t * shelter_index_t) / (w_services_t - w_shelter_t). Y/Y is the standard 12-month % change on L. Route choice ('level-then-Y/Y' vs 'subtract weighted Y/Ys'): we use level-then-Y/Y per StatCan / BoC convention for published ex-aggregate CPI variants. The two routes differ when basket cycles change within the 12-month comparison window; level-then-Y/Y holds the current-month cycle constant across both endpoints. Inputs: cpi_services (NSA, v41691230) and cpi_shelter (NSA, v41691050).
